Class CavePaintingBuilding

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.BuildingCard
it.polimi.ingsw.model.BuildingCards.CavePaintingBuilding
public class CavePaintingBuilding extends BuildingCard
Represents a specialized BuildingCard that models a Cave Painting. This building provides a dynamic food bonus scaled by the number of specific character types present within a player's tribe.

  • Constructor Details

    • CavePaintingBuilding

      public CavePaintingBuilding(String id, int era, int minPlayer, boolean isObtainable, int foodCost, int prestigePoints, int extraFood, CharacterTypeCount typeCount)
      Constructs a new CavePaintingBuilding with the specified attributes, resource multiplier, and type filter.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the card
      era - the historical era or age this card belongs to
      minPlayer - the minimum number of players required for this card to be active
      isObtainable - true if the card can currently be acquired by players
      foodCost - the amount of food required to construct/buy this building
      prestigePoints - the raw prestige or victory points awarded by this card
      extraFood - the amount of food granted as a multiplier for each matching card type
      typeCount - the CharacterTypeCount strategy used to calculate how many matching cards are in the tribe

  • Method Details

    • getBonusFood

      public int getBonusFood(Tribe t)
      Calculates the total bonus food generated by this building based on the contents of the specified tribe.
      Parameters:
      t - the Tribe whose cards will be counted to evaluate the bonus
      Returns:
      the total calculated food bonus (extraFood multiplied by the number of matching cards)
